recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見數個大型紅血球前驅細胞，細胞核內有淡染、玻璃樣的病毒包涵體，染色質被推擠到核膜邊緣形成一圈深色環（lantern cell），是微小病毒 B19 感染的特徵。
features: Scattered giant pronormoblasts with large round nuclei
Glassy, pale eosinophilic to clear intranuclear inclusions
Chromatin marginated against the nuclear membrane, forming a dark rim
Adjacent clusters of immature erythroid precursors with round nuclei and open chromatin
Background of maturing granulocytes, eosinophils and fat spaces in a cellular marrow
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows cellular marrow with a mixed population of myeloid and erythroid elements. Scattered large erythroid precursors contain glassy, pale intranuclear inclusions that push the chromatin to the periphery of the nucleus, producing a dark rim around a cleared center. Clusters of early erythroid precursors are present, while late normoblasts are not conspicuous in this field. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection of erythroid progenitors; confirmation by B19 immunohistochemistry or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: CMV inclusions are large, dark owl-eye intranuclear inclusions with a halo, often with granular cytoplasmic inclusions, and involve endothelial or stromal cells rather than being confined to erythroid precursors.

Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of monotonous proerythroblasts without viral inclusions and with an erythroid predominance, whereas here the precursors are scattered with glassy inclusions and marginated chromatin.
Megaloblastic precursors show open, sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony across all maturation stages and giant metamyelocytes, not glassy intranuclear inclusions.
HSV/VZV cause multinucleation with nuclear molding and ground-glass chromatin, usually with necrosis, rather than isolated giant erythroid precursors.
